description: Defines a SwiftUI View called ContextUsageBar which visually indicates the proportion of used tokens in a given context, with adaptive coloring based on usage percentage.

classes.name: ContextUsageBar
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a horizontal bar representing the usage of a context window, with color indicators based on usage levels.

methods.name: clampedFractionUsed
methods.description: Calculates and returns the ratio of used tokens to context tokens, clamped between 0 and 1.

methods.name: percentUsed
methods.description: Returns the percentage of used tokens relative to the context, or nil if invalid.

methods.name: accessibilityValue
methods.description: Provides an accessibility label indicating the percent of context tokens used.

methods.name: barBody
methods.description: Builds the visual representation of the usage bar with fill and stroke colors, and adjusts fill width based on usage.
